# AMPR runtime provenance (TITAN CORE)

The active `libSceAmpr.sprx` is the **unmodified upstream ampr-emu-ng v0.4.1 release** (quer3q/ampr-emu-ng), SHA-256 `9c7c41b3216bc4f877d67e3c2e5c9c8f9ffabdd5065f4f3fe0dd98fa7228386f`. This binary exactly matches the owner-provided `libSceAmpr.sprx` attachment and the released Kraken Mount v0.3.0 bundled library. Build verification pins its SHA-256.

The earlier `chmod v0.1` / `PLAY NO LIMIT` launch-notice customizations belonged to the **old** 0.4.0 binary. Those archived source ZIPs are retained for history but are **not** built into the active 0.4.1 library. Do not claim that the current runtime shows the custom notice; preserve current upstream compatibility and authorship.

The `libSceAmpr-upstream-v0.4.0.sprx` file is a historical reference only, and its SHA-256 remains separately verified. Runtime PS5 compatibility and game launch require hardware validation.
